How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Jammu Project Assistant Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Project Assistant post at IIT Jammu is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Chemistry from a recognized university or institution to be eligible for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant position is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month, exclusive of any House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Assistant position at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Jammu Project Assistant recruitment is strictly online through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant role at IIT Jammu involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position at IIT Jammu is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
